---

This is the repository of Extra Biome Travels exclusively for 1.12.2 and is not affiliated with Traverse or ports of ExtrabiomesXL. Suggestions meant for these projects will immediately be closed and marked as invalid.

Note that before making a suggestion, the following will not be taken into consideration:

1. Requests to port the mod to other Minecraft versions (e.g. 1.7.10 or 1.16.5).

---

There are also common requests that we're already aware of:

1. Dynamic Trees / Dramatic Trees Support
2. Realistic Terrain Generation (RTG) Support

These will eventually be added into the mod or will be handled by an addon, please do not spam the repository with these same requests.
